text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen... I've got
shivers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This race is one of the biggest sprint
events there
is, and we've been training
day and night for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we still have to do everything
we can to
gain attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I update the blog and, while I have it
open,
decide to check the number of
views...
choice_data_list: (I should upload the finished 4-koma while I have the chance.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You look like you've seen a ghost.
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan peeks over my shoulder,
then
freezes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
So our views are in the single digits
this month.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Views were going up at a decent pace
until
February, but they've been
plummeting since.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've heard it's best to refresh the page at
times
like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...So much for that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There must be some kind of error. I've
been as
active as ever.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People wouldn't just stop reading all of
a sudden.
It doesn't make sense.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank y...ou... Oooh...
choice_data_list: I'll look into it thoroughly once the race is over.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Sniff! Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... It looks like spring hates me
more than
usual this year...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But there's no way I'm letting it stop me
from
racing. Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I have a fever. I'm just kind
of fuzzy
and loopy...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can't sleep when I'm sleepy, but I conk
out when
I'm not even tired.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I hate spring.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Good idea.
choice_data_list: Let's visit the clinic once the race is over.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But this is no good. I have to get revved
up and
ready to go before the race.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm just going to get some sunshine. Cough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen starts on a

somewhat gloomy note.
